title: An Unprotected Female at the Pyramids
sourceTitle: An Unprotected Female at the Pyramids
author: Anthony Trollope
description: "An Unprotected Female at the Pyramids" by Anthony Trollope is a novella written during the mid-19th century, likely in the Victorian era.
longDescription: This work delves into the complexities of social interactions and attitudes towards women traveling alone, through the eyes of distinct characters embarking on a journey to the Pyramids of Egypt.

authorInfo.bio: Anthony Trollope (1815–1882) is the author of The Warden. This historical edition is part of the author’s surviving literary work. Explore the linked biographical record for their life and bibliography.
